overloadMerges.note: Documented default of howMany (1 element) captured as a sentinel/description rather than left implicit, and array marked inout since it is mutated (shrunk) in place.

params.name: array
params.description: Array to shrink; mutated in place.

params.name: howMany
params.description: Number of consecutive elements to delete starting at where; the array shrinks by this amount. If omitted, exactly 1 element is deleted.
